item.title: Allow specifying the model for subagents in runSubagent
item.body:
### Problem

When using agent mode, the `runSubagent` tool spawns subagents that always inherit the model currently selected in the main Copilot model dropdown. There is no way to specify a different model for subagents.

### Proposed Solution

Add an optional `model` parameter to the `runSubagent` tool, for example:

```json
{
  "prompt": "...",
  "description": "...",
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4.6"
}
```

If omitted, the current behavior (inherit the main model) would be preserved. When specified, the subagent would use the requested model (subject to the user's subscription/plan).

### Use Cases

- **Model specialization:** Use a fast/cheap model for simple lookups and a stronger model for complex reasoning within the same agent session.
- **Cost control:** Delegate simple subtasks to lighter models while keeping the main agent on a premium model, saving quota.
- **Diversity of thought:** Dispatch the same question to multiple different models in parallel and synthesize their varied perspectives for more robust answers.
